description: The Uruguayan Ministry of Transport and Public Works publishes a data and statistics listing with 749 items, filterable by theme and by year from 2010 to 2026. The listing read on 2026-09-28 covers construction prices, road traffic, the central railway, public tenders, road transport, road works prices, road infrastructure, road maintenance and traffic and road safety. The latest items are monthly reference price bulletins of materials and maintenance for firms bidding in public tenders (for example bulletin 698 of August 2026 as PDF) and the official construction price list (list 606 for June 2026 as a 104 KB spreadsheet, with earlier monthly lists). Coverage is Uruguay. Access is free download; the terms of use of gub.uy were not read. Caveats: the listing mixes price bulletins, reports and statistics, so the road inventory and safety items must be opened one by one, and several are PDF. It supports cost and capacity planning for road and building works, such as pricing repairs after a flood with official unit rates. No related Uruguayan transport data record is catalogued.
